title: Zelda: A Link Between Worlds Listed As 'Playable With NSO', But Let's Not Jump To Conclusions
summary:
An upcoming new library? Probably not...

Nintendo's official website for the Zelda series has updated its entry for A Link Between Worlds with a mysterious 'Playable with Nintendo Switch Online' icon, leading some to believe that it's a hint of an upcoming expansion to the paid service. However, we're not so sure.

The site is home to a series timeline, listing every mainline game from the NES original through to the Ocarina of Time remake. The likes of A Link to the Past, Link's Awakening and Oracle of Seasons are all marked with a 'Playable on NSO' button and, indeed, you can play all of them on the service. A Link Between Worlds has been locked to the 3DS since its launch back in 2013, however. Not only is it decidedly not playable on Nintendo Switch Online, but there isn't even a library for the console.

title: Review: CRKD Ult Pro Controller For Switch 1 & 2 - A Decent Pad Let Down By Awful Shoulder & Bumper Buttons
summary:
Feels like it's gonna CRK.

CRKD is the latest accessory manufacturer to produce a premium alternative to Nintendo’s own Pro Controller on Switch 2, but it’s one that needs a lot of refinement if it’s to become a legitimate competitor.

Priced at $69.99 / €79.99 / £64.99, the Ult Pro sits below the Pro Controller and roughly at par with Gulikit’s excellent TT line, price-wise. It comes feature-packed with TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) analogue sticks, Hall Effect triggers, four back buttons, two extra bumper inputs, four profile modes, adjustable rumble, a charging stand, and more.

title: Nintendo Reveals Switch 2 Black Friday Deals (US)
summary:
The dis-countdown begins.

Nintendo has revealed a bunch of offers in the US for this year's Black Friday in a hope to boost its sales ahead of the holiday season.

The headline here is a Switch 2 hardware bundle, which contains the console, a digital copy of Mario Kart World, and a 3-month individual membership to Nintendo Switch Online. Priced at $499.99, this effectively wipes out the $50 price hike we saw earlier this year. This discount will be applicable from 22nd November to 5th December.
